result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is visually truncated and overflows the viewport, preventing users from seeing the complete content.

issues.description: The third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol) in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off on the right edge. The card and its text are partially hidden, with only a portion visible on screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container properly constrains all child cards and either allows horizontal scrolling to reveal the full card, or adjust the layout to display only 2 cards per row with proper spacing. The text 'Trattoria Piccol' also appears truncated - ensure full restaurant names are visible.
